# Mantle Swap

> Mantle Swap is a non-custodial web interface for swapping MNT, USDC, USDT and other tokens on Mantle, an Ethereum layer-2. Users connect their own wallet, review a routed quote and sign each transaction. The site never holds funds or keys.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- Network: Mantle, a modular Ethereum layer-2 that settles to Ethereum.
- Gas token: MNT pays for every transaction on Mantle.
- Typical pairs: MNT, USDC, USDT and ETH, plus other ERC-20 tokens.
- Tokens must already be on Mantle in your wallet, moved there by bridge or exchange withdrawal.
- Non-custodial: the user signs every swap and the interface never holds funds or keys.

## Pages
